'''Yuriem'''<ref name="Codex" /> was a [[Zakuulan]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]<ref name="Human" /> who held the title of [[High Justice]] in the [[Eternal Empire]]<ref name="Codex" /> at some point prior to the Empire's [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that began in [[3636 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Yuriem was accused of profaning the name of [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]], the [[Immortality/Legends|Immortal]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], and as a result, the Zakuulan High Justice was put to [[Death/Legends|death]] in an extravagant public execution organized by the [[entertainer]] [[Indo Zal]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yuriem was mentioned in the Codex entry for Indo Zal in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'',<ref name="Codex" /> the [[2016]] Digital Expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Launch">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20161202-1|text=Knights of the Eternal Throne: Now Live!}}</ref>
